articles.company_name: The Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V.
articles.summary: Sydney, Australia, 23 November 2026 | The Magnum Ice Cream Company has restarted production of the iconic Magnum Ego at its Minto facility in New South Wales this month. The 2026 relaunch reaffirms The Magnum Ice Cream Company’s broader commitment to Australian manufacturing and consumer preferences, with an AU$6million investment in the site...
articles.title: The Magnum Ice Cream Company announces the return of the Magnum Ego in Australia
